description: Langelier Saturation Index for your pool or spa from pH, water temperature, calcium hardness and total alkalinity, using the factor table and formula in state pool rules, plus the pH that would balance it. Formula: SI = pH + TF + CF + AF − 12.1 (12.2 when TDS is above 1,000 ppm). TF, CF and AF come from the temperature, calcium hardness and alkalinity factor table; when a reading falls between rows the table method uses the next greater row. pH for SI = 0: 12.1 − TF − CF − AF.

tds_ppm.description: Total dissolved solids (0 if unknown) (ppm); default 0
